faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, K. K. Birla Goa Campus for a Junior Research Fellow position under a project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech in relevant branch with NET/GATE or an M.Tech/M.E. in relevant engineering branches with first division.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37000 per month.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 26 October 2026. Applicants must ensure timely submission before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for BITS Pilani JRF Recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. Candidates need to send their applications along with their curriculum vitae to the designated email address.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for applying to this Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting candidates based on their submitted applications and CVs, followed by an online or personal interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the project for this position?
faq.answer: The project-based engagement for the Junior Research Fellow is for a duration of one year, with a chance to apply for a PhD degree.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official website and notification details?
faq.answer: You can visit the official BITS Pilani website at www.bits-pilani.ac.in to check further details and official notification information.
